assertions.title: SIGWINCH mid-stream resilience (no token drops/duplicates/focus loss)

steps.action: Verify Tab navigation still works after resize

summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. VAL-SKEL-012: Terminal guard fires at 50x10 with 'resize to ≥60x15' message; TUI launches at 60x15 minimum. VAL-SKEL-015: SIGWINCH mid-stream resize (120x40→80x24) preserves layout without corruption, token drops, or focus loss; Tab navigation works post-resize.
